data.name: Luai

historical_references.reference: Luai ibn Mi'mar al-Qaysi was a famous Arab poet and a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was known for his beautiful poetry and his bravery in battles. He was born in the city of Al-Qayrawan in present-day Tunisia and died around 632 AD.
historical_references.context: Arab Poet and Companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)

historical_references.reference: Luai ibn Sa'id Al-Khawlan was an influential figure in the early Islamic state of the Rashidun Caliphate. He was a leader of the Bani Asad tribe and played an important role in the Battle of Mutah against the Byzantines in 629 AD. He was also one of the negotiators in the Treaty of Hudaybiyah between the Muslims and the Meccan tribes in 628 AD.
historical_references.context: Leader of Bani Asad Tribe and Negotiator in Treaty of Hudaybiyah
